mapper.select: SELECT n.OPP_ID AS "opportunityId",n.NEED_SN::int AS "needSn",n.JOB_CD AS "jobCode", COALESCE(j.CODE_NM,n.JOB_CD) AS "jobName",n.NEED_CNT::int AS "requiredCount",n.BGN_YM AS "startMonth" FROM TB_SL_OPP_NEED n LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE j ON j.CODE_GRP_ID='JOB' AND j.CODE=n.JOB_CD WHERE n.OPP_ID IN #{id} ORDER BY n.OPP_ID,n.NEED_SN
